name: WantToBook Online Booking
author: casbizz

sections.description:
WantToBook Online Booking connects a WordPress website to the hosted WantToBook booking flow.

The plugin provides:

  • A WantToBook Booking Form block for the block editor.
  • The [wanttobook] shortcode for classic editors and page builders.
  • Central settings for the organization slug, booking form height, and default appearance.
  • A responsive, accessible embed that works with any WordPress theme.

WantToBook is a trade name of CasBizz Holding B.V. This is the official plugin developed and maintained by CasBizz Holding B.V.

WantToBook is a hosted software service. An active WantToBook organization is required. Availability, services, prices, customer details, payments, and bookings are processed by WantToBook rather than stored by this plugin.

Service information: https://wanttobook.com/wordpress
Terms of service: https://wanttobook.com/algemene-voorwaarden
Privacy statement: https://wanttobook.com/privacy

Privacy

This plugin does not add tracking and does not store customer or booking details in WordPress. Pages containing the booking form connect visitors to the WantToBook service. Site owners should describe this external processing in their privacy information. See the WantToBook privacy statement for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate WantToBook Online Booking.
  3. Open Settings > WantToBook.
  4. Enter the organization slug shown in your WantToBook booking page URL.
  5. Confirm that the WordPress site address matches the website configured for your organization in WantToBook.
  6. Add the WantToBook Booking Form block to a page, or insert [wanttobook].
sections.faq:
Where do I find the organization slug?

It is the organization part of the public booking URL. For example, the slug in https://wanttobook.com/example-business/reserveer is example-business.

Why is the booking form blocked?

For security, WantToBook only allows the booking form to be embedded by the website configured for that organization. Make sure the WordPress site address, including the use of www, matches the website stored in WantToBook.

Can I use a shortcode?

Yes. Use [wanttobook] with the global settings, or override them for one page with [wanttobook slug="example-business" height="900" appearance="dark"]. Appearance accepts system, light, or dark.

Does the plugin store customer or booking information in WordPress?

No. The plugin stores only its organization slug and display height. Booking data is submitted directly to the hosted WantToBook service.

Does the plugin load an external service?

Yes. When a page contains the block or shortcode, it loads the booking form from wanttobook.com. That request is necessary to provide the booking functionality.
